title: Current Main Registration Form
purpose: Initial desktop capture of the actual current /register route.
what_it_demonstrates: The main React registration card shows the real reader information, account credentials, terms consent and Create account action.

title: Empty Form — Visible Validation Errors
purpose: Submit the current form with no reader details.
what_it_demonstrates: The real current UI displays the validation summary and visible field-level errors rather than leaving the output ambiguous.

title: Invalid Email and Mobile Test
purpose: Enter an incomplete email and an invalid Indian mobile number.
what_it_demonstrates: Current client-side rules visibly flag both contact fields and explain the expected mobile-number format.

title: Age and Pincode Failure Test
purpose: Enter an underage date and short pincode.
what_it_demonstrates: The actual current validation reports the 13-year age rule and six-digit pincode requirement.

title: Password Strength and Confirmation Test
purpose: Enter a weak password and mismatched confirmation.
what_it_demonstrates: The current UI shows a Weak password-strength label and a visible password-matching error.

title: Terms Consent Failure Test
purpose: Complete reader details but leave the terms unchecked before submit.
what_it_demonstrates: The current form blocks the next action and displays the reader-terms error as an actual test result.

title: All Valid Reader Details — Pass State
purpose: Fill every current validation requirement with valid reader details.
what_it_demonstrates: The current UI shows green valid states and the All checks passed message before any account is created.

title: Responsive Mobile Valid Form
purpose: Capture the current valid registration form at 320 px.
what_it_demonstrates: The main CSS mobile breakpoint presents the current form in one column without horizontal overflow.
